package.description: A simple menu-bar app that allows you to control an Apple TV from your desktop.

en-US.description: A simple menu-bar app that allows you to control an Apple TV from your desktop.
en-US.name: ATV Desktop Remote
en-US.releaseNotes:
Version 2.2.1 changes:
- auto-keyboard (may be buggy in some apps, disable in context menu)
- Bug fixes (most are npm audit fixes)
- Better tray icon that looks more like the real remote
Considering dropping intel-only releases for a universal release that contains both. It's slightly larger but can be pruned if someone is really concerned, but this is just a thought at this point. If anyone has feelings or opinions about this I'd be happy to listen.
